statement: Implement State-space sequence models: compare S4-style recurrence and input-dependent selective state spaces on variable-length copying. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use generated-copying; required output: [N,T] symbols -> [N,T,V] logits. Evaluate sequence_accuracy (maximize). Compare recurrence and parallel scan numerically; test longer unseen sequences. Required ablation: Remove input-dependent selection while matching state dimension. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
